mathematical_contract.regularity: H and its lifted-parameter derivative have no common unit-square solution, so each component branch is a graph over the retained parameter and distinct graphs cannot meet or exchange order
mathematical_contract.critical_events: all unit-square solutions of H and its retained-parameter derivative are projected, paired, and replayed exactly; unresolved Cartesian candidates reject the certificate
mathematical_contract.closed_domain: transverse roots through open lifted-domain edges reject the certificate; an interior edge root is retained only when the same exact pair is an enumerated turning event
mathematical_contract.one_graph: ordered endpoint, turning-event, and endpoint pairs partition the graph into oriented monotone overlap cells
mathematical_contract.multiple_graphs: when no turning event exists, equal root counts at retained fibers 0, 1/2, and 1 plus absence of lifted folds lets fiber order pair each disjoint monotone graph without Cartesian expansion
mathematical_contract.branch: the selected-normal predicate is proved rootless on the whole component and signed independently at each ordered midpoint root
mathematical_contract.strict: STRICT uses exact resultants, root isolation, bivariate replay, parameter refinement, and sign classification
mathematical_contract.approximate_512: APPROXIMATE_512 follows the same proof graph; only inherited Hyperreal equality terminals may stop at 512 bits, and no approximate point, cell, orientation, or topology is synthesized
mathematical_contract.failure_semantics: multiple graphs with turning events, projection folds, singular/shared-derivative components, transverse domain entry or exit, and boundary-coincident components remain explicit Boundary or predicate uncertainty

release_benchmark.method: five all-feature release processes pinned to CPU 11; 100 iterations per public implicit-component candidate/contact lane
release_benchmark.interpretation: both changes are sub-percent steady-state noise; the widened topology does not regress the existing monotone public route
